tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Use when someone looks for an expat tax advisor or relocation agency in the Netherlands with specific services, a city or English service. Returns the providers that meet every requirement, in the ranking order of the Expat Checked guide, with score, profile URL and the sourced facts that show each

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Use when you need everything Expat Checked published about one provider: every fact with source_url and checked_on, the score per rubric criterion, the facts the provider does not publish, rank and profile URL.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Use when asked how Expat Checked selects, scores and ranks providers or how often it checks them. Returns inclusion criteria, the rubric with point rules, the ranking rule, the check cadence and the disclosure, with a link to the methodology page and the generation time of the data export.

tools.name: get_ai_research
tools.description: Use when asked which providers AI assistants name for expats in the Netherlands. Returns the latest Expat Checked measurement for the category: date, configuration, cell counts, the most named providers and directories, and the most cited domains. This is a measurement of AI answers, not the Expat C

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_provider · Public sink: get_provider.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_provider · Public sink: get_provider

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
